source.source_title: Let's Be Good Citizens at School
source.why_this_clip: A boy on a schoolyard holds a baseball bat across his body in both hands; the bat swings from a slant to level and then shifts as he turns it while looking down. The shot starts after the whip pan that ends at 6.75 s and the boy turns out of frame after 9.25 s, so 7.0 to 9.0 s keeps the bat whole and large in frame.
